_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score and tape remain inside the Complacency band with no confirmed range break; coil dominates despite latent downside from dead ETF flows and rising venue intake.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative supply-flow note is cautionary but silent on forward phase
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound and fear_greed holds roughly 45-55 with no sustained ETF-flow or volatility shock
next_move.invalidated_if: A clean range break that pushes fear_greed through 46 or 55, or an ETF-flow/VIX impulse that forces the score into Anxiety or Disbelief
